// ignoreCommand: Always build. Vercel's default monorepo skip-check runs `git diff --quiet HEAD^ HEAD -- .`, but the repo-root .vercelignore allowlists only this directory — which strips .git, so git exits non-zero ('Not a git repository') and every deployment reads as FAILED. This site is static (buildCommand: null), so there is no build to skip anyway; exit 1 means 'do build'.
